harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster on node1/node2/node3 holding application data, then added node4 as a fourth member that received the existing data via SST and now accepts writes like the others. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol on all four nodes with proven boot-id changes and verified cluster/data recovery after each restart.
actions_performed: Installed MariaDB 10.4.34 + galera-4 from archive.mariadb.org rhel7-amd64 repo on node1-node4 (MariaDB's current official repo no longer supports RHEL7)
Opened firewalld ports 3306, 4444, 4567/tcp+udp, 4568 on all four nodes
Diagnosed SELinux blocking mariabackup SST (socat bind denied) and set SELinux to permissive, persisted in /etc/selinux/config, on all four nodes

Configured /etc/my.cnf.d/galera.cnf on node1-3 with wsrep_cluster_address=gcomm://node1,node2,node3 and mariabackup SST auth; generated a random SST password on node1 and propagated it via the cluster SSH key rather than embedding it in commands
Bootstrapped Galera on node1 (galera_new_cluster), created sstuser DB account, started mariadb on node2 and node3 which joined via SST to form a 3-node cluster (wsrep_cluster_size=3, Synced/Primary)
Created appdb.orders application table with 5 seed rows on node1 and confirmed replication to node2 and node3

Reconfigured node4 galera.cnf and updated node1-3 cluster_address to include node4; started mariadb on node4 which joined via SST and received all existing rows; verified wsrep_cluster_size=4, Synced/Primary
Confirmed node4 accepts writes and that they replicate back to node1
Enabled the mariadb systemd unit (previously disabled) on all four nodes so it restarts automatically on reboot
Captured a boot_id plus cluster-health and row-count baseline on all four nodes
Restarted node4, then node3, then node2, then node1 one at a time (quorum preserved by the other three each time) via 'sudo reboot' run in the background so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled each node after its reboot until exec access returned, confirmed a changed boot_id, and verified mariadb active with wsrep_cluster_size=4, Synced/Primary, and correct row count
After all four restarts, performed a final write on node1 and confirmed it replicated to node4

evidence.requirement: 3-node Galera cluster bootstrapped on node1-3 holding application data
evidence.summary: node1 bootstrapped (cluster_size=1, Synced); node2 and node3 joined via SST reaching cluster_size=3 Synced/Primary; appdb.orders created with 5 rows on node1 and confirmed present on node2 and node3

evidence.requirement: node4 added as 4th member, carries existing data, accepts writes
evidence.summary: node4 joined via SST reaching cluster_size=4 Synced/Primary with all 5 pre-existing rows; wrote a test row on node4 and confirmed it replicated to node1 (row_count=6, wsrep_incoming_addresses lists all 4 IPs)

evidence.requirement: Prerequisite fixes: package availability, firewall, SELinux blocking SST
evidence.summary: MariaDB-server/galera-4 installed from archive repo; firewalld ports opened; SELinux AVC denial identified via journalctl and resolved by setting permissive, allowing SST to succeed

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 0d6209e2... with cluster_size=4 Synced/Primary and 6 rows; reboot acked; post-reboot boot_id 08d10bbb... (changed); recovered to cluster_size=4 Synced/Primary with 6 rows intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 325732f1... cluster_size=4 Synced/Primary 6 rows; reboot acked; post-reboot boot_id 847db90d... (changed); recovered to cluster_size=4 Synced/Primary 6 rows

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id fe422859... cluster_size=4 Synced/Primary 6 rows; reboot acked; post-reboot boot_id cf504668... (changed); recovered to cluster_size=4 Synced/Primary 6 rows

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id b35fad86... cluster_size=4 Synced/Primary 6 rows; reboot acked; post-reboot boot_id 02dced3e... (changed); recovered to cluster_size=4 Synced/Primary 6 rows

evidence.requirement: Final end-to-end verification after all restarts complete
evidence.summary: Wrote a new row on node1 post-restart-cycle and confirmed row_count=7 on node4, proving writes still propagate across the fully-restarted 4-node cluster
